notes: the first «ح» branch ends at «وكيع» with no further names written, so it is read as it stands and not extended
the second branch carries the saying: «عن أبيه» is the father of Isa, a relation link, and his words are the Prophet's saying
the gloss «- يعني» is absent here; the gap at «أبيه» is not filled from other sources
